headline: Microchip lists system-level AMS verification across full-chip and chiplet boundaries
fact: Microchip posted a Technical Staff Engineer role for system-level AMS verification and power and signal integrity on SoCs and chiplet platforms. The description covers subsystem, full-chip, and cross-chiplet AMS and SPICE simulation, mature-node analog integrated with advanced-node digital, multi-voltage domains, methodology development, silicon bring-up, and simulation-to-silicon correlation.

sources.title: Technical Staff Engineer - AMS Verification
sources.summary: Official Microchip Workday role dated June 14, 2026, for system-level AMS, full-chip and chiplet simulation, methodology, and silicon correlation.
